An '''unidentified embezzler''' lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], the embezzler worked for [[Ribba]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who owned a supposedly legitimate textile business. This individual began to embezzle funds from the Hutt, however, and once Ribba found out, the embezzler was forced to flee. This individual traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]], where they were pursued by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] working for Ribba. Though the preconditions of the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] declared that the embezzler was to be taken alive, while within a [[Unidentified Celanon bar|bar]], a [[Bar fight on Celanon|firefight]] broke out, resulting in the embezzler's [[Death/Legends|death]].
